**Finding: Deviation (medium) — GOVLAW**

§ 28.1 chose Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction — outside the accepted list and bordering the walk-away position (exclusive foreign venue). It also contradicted § 28.2, which already gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County. No arbitration clause appears anywhere in the document, so the only issue is the law/forum selection.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`): in § 28.1, replace "Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction" with "the laws of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction" — the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position and eliminates the internal conflict, leaving § 28.2 and the § 28.3 escalation process untouched. Fallbacks (Delaware/California, or England and Wales with London courts) are flagged in the comment.
